component.name: DumbConvert
component.summary: Convert camera scans of film negatives

description.p: A quick film-negative converter for negatives scanned with a digital camera over a white light. Drop a roll in, get good colour straight away, nudge a few faders, export. Built on NegPy.

ul.li: A roll is measured as one, so its frames share the same colour
Six faders, like a lab scanner, and everything works from the keyboard
Crop to film formats, dust and scratch removal, contact sheets
Film stock, camera, lens, date and place written into the files
JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, PNG, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP or DNG
